title: 2026 Annual investor update
text: Back to Investors GlencoreInvestors2026 Annual investor update2026 Investor updateNotice of 2026 Annual Investor UpdateShareGlencore plc will host an annual investor update presentation on Monday, 7 December 2026 at 11.00 am UK.Share2020 Investor updateArrangementsAt 10.30 am UK the investor update presentation slides will be available for download from the Publications section of our website.WebcastA live audio webcast starting at 11.00 am UK will be accessible at: https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/q9utwefg To listen to the webcast please make sure your speakers are unmuted on your computer or laptop. If you are using a mobile device, please use your handset's volume controls.ReplayIf you are unable to attend the live audio webcast, an on-demand replay will be available within 24 hours of the presentation ending at the same link as the live webcast. The presentation will also be archived on our website.For further information please contact:InvestorsMartin Fewings     t: +41 41 709 28 80     m: +41 79 737 56 42 m: +61 428 657 415  martin.fewings@glencore.comAustralian Investors australia.investors@glencore.com.au MediaCharles Watenphul     t: +41 41 709 24 62     m: +41 79 904 33 20     charles.watenphul@glencore.comFrancis De Rosa     t: +61 2 8247 6352     m: +61 417 074 751      francis.de.rosa@glencore.com
